source_name: OECD FDI positions by counterpart area, BMD4
source_method: Inward direct investment position; net FDI; all entities; total economy; immediate counterpart; USD millions; China divided by World.
model_policy: The five available country shares are retained as evidence variables. Investment Exposure remains unavailable because the same definition does not cover all ten countries.

source_tier_policy.tier_1: OECD or Eurostat common-definition inward FDI position by China and World denominator.
source_tier_policy.tier_2: National central-bank direct-investment or IIP evidence; retained as partial unless definition and denominator match Tier 1.
source_tier_policy.tier_3: Other official national investment statistics; contextual only until definition and denominator are verified.
